testcase.name: Scenario: Keep a panel hidden when redocking the floating ribbon: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:123:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep a panel hidden when redocking the floating ribbon ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the floating 3D Model ribbon shows the Modify group ✔ When the user hides Modify through Show Panels ✔ Then the floating ribbon no longer shows the Modify group ✔ When the user docks the ribbon at the top ✔ Then the top ribbon does not show the Modify panel ✔ When the user opens Show Panels on the top ribbon ✔ Then Modify is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Modify ✔ Then the Modify panel is visible again
